name: elevenlabs-auto-voiceover
description: Автоматическая озвучка в ElevenLabs через антидетект-браузер Dolphin Anty

scripts.package:win: npm run bundle && npx -y @yao-pkg/pkg build/bundle.cjs --targets node20-win-x64 --output release/win/elevenlabs-auto-voiceover.exe && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs win
scripts.package:mac: npm run bundle && npx -y @yao-pkg/pkg build/bundle.cjs --targets node20-macos-x64 --output release/mac/elevenlabs-auto-voiceover && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run bundle && npx -y @yao-pkg/pkg build/bundle.cjs --targets node20-linux-x64 --output release/linux/elevenlabs-auto-voiceover && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs linux
